note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor, after the user-namespace conversion): every tagged unit now opens with `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }`, which re-executes the test in its own user, network and mount namespace and carries the child's fail or skip to the parent (Enter, internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go), and the file builds under plain linux instead of integration && linux. RFC 9568 Section 8.2.2 says "the Active Router MUST respond to the ND Neighbor Solicitation message with the Virtual Router MAC address for the Virtual Router." TestVRRPNonOwnerMasterAnswersNDWithVirtualMACOnly, otherwise unchanged, sees the physical MAC in the Target Link-Layer Address option with the address on the parent, only the virtual MAC once it lives on the macvlan, and no advertisement once removed; TestVRRPOwnerAnswersWithVirtualMACOnly gives the owner case with and without the owner filter. Verdict enforced.
